info.title: Stogas Gateway API
info.description: The Stogas Gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible surface. Authenticate requests with your Stogas API key, and the gateway will relay the request to the configured upstream provider.

servers.description: Gateway origin. Endpoint paths include their API version.

get.description: Returns the active public gateway catalog used for model discovery, aliases, routing, and prices.
Returns an OpenAI-compatible list of catalog model IDs accepted by the gateway.

post.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible chat completion. The gateway resolves the requested model and route through the compiled Stogas catalog, applies deployment facts such as implied service tier, rejects unsupported parameters, and then relays the request to the configured provider.

200.description: Successful completion. Non-streaming requests return JSON; streaming requests return Server-Sent Events.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a chat completion chunk; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

post.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible Responses API response. The gateway resolves the requested model and route through the compiled Stogas catalog, applies deployment facts such as implied service tier, rejects unsupported parameters, and then relays the request to the configured provider.

200.description: Successful response. Non-streaming requests return JSON; streaming requests return Server-Sent Events.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a Responses API event; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

bearerAuth.description: Pass the Stogas API key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. This is the canonical OpenAI-compatible header.

authorizationHeader.name: Authorization
authorizationHeader.description: Pass the Stogas API key directly as `Authorization: <token>`. The gateway normalizes this to the canonical Bearer authentication path.

apiKeyHeader.name: api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

xApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
xApiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `x-api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

xGoogApiKeyHeader.name: x-goog-api-key
xGoogApiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `x-goog-api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

ReturnExtraFields.name: X-Stogas-Return-Extra-Fields
ReturnExtraFields.description: Comma-separated catalog-defined Stogas metadata fields to include under `stogas`, such as `provider`, `model_requested`, `model_deployment`, `latency`, `provider_response_headers`, `raw_request`, and `raw_response`.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: The request was malformed, missing required fields, or specifying an unavailable model.

error.message: Invalid text completion request: the 'messages' array cannot be empty.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized: The API key provided was missing or invalid.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment Required: Returned when your account balance is insufficient or the API key lifetime or recurring spend limit is exhausted.

error.message: Insufficient balance. Please add funds to your Stogas account to continue making requests.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: The API key is disabled or expired. Expired keys are disabled automatically before the error is returned.

NotFound.description: Not Found: The requested endpoint route does not exist.

error.message: Not Found: The requested endpoint '/v1/chat/compl' does not exist.

Conflict.description: Conflict: The gateway request ID was already finalized, expired, or reused with different hold parameters. Generate a new request ID and retry.

error.message: Request already finalized; generate a new requestId

PayloadTooLarge.description: Payload Too Large: The request body exceeds the gateway's maximum allowed size.

error.message: Payload Too Large: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size of 100MB.

RateLimited.description: Rate Limited: The API key token bucket does not currently have capacity for another request.

InternalError.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred within the gateway or upstream provider.

CatalogUnavailable.description: Internal Server Error: The gateway catalog is not available.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service Unavailable: The gateway could not reach the billing database while placing the authorization hold. The provider is not called and no usage telemetry is written.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp assigned to the generated catalog payload.

graph.description: Resolved catalog graph: authors, models, deployments, providers, routes, and gateway endpoints.

indexes.description: Public lookup indexes, including provider-endpoint-scoped request slugs.

id.description: Model ID or alias accepted by the gateway.

oneOf.description: Known provider ID or provider slug, such as `openai`, `open-ai`, or `anthropic`.

only.description: Provider IDs or provider slugs allowed to serve this request.

order.description: Preferred provider order after the optional `only` filter is applied.

oneOf.description: Stogas-owned provider routing rules. At least one of `only` or `order` is required.

ProviderRoutingPreference.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible chat request fields parsed by the Stogas HTTP API.

model.description: Catalog model or deployment slug to route to, optionally provider-qualified, such as `gpt-5.5-latest`, `gpt-5.5-flex-latest`, or `openai/gpt-5.5-priority-latest`.

provider.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

rules.description: Alias for `provider`. Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

messages.description: Conversation messages. Stogas currently accepts text-only content only.

audio.description: Not supported by the text-only Stogas MVP. Requests that set audio are rejected before upstream dispatch.

fallbacks.description: Not supported. Stogas fallback policy is server-owned and client-supplied fallbacks are rejected.

function_call.description: Not supported. Deprecated Chat Completions function-calling fields are rejected; use `tools` and `tool_choice`.

functions.description: Not supported. Deprecated Chat Completions function definitions are rejected; use `tools`.

container.description: Not supported. Stateful provider containers require separate lifecycle, isolation, and pricing controls.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions frequency penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

logit_bias.description: OpenAI-only token bias map. Values must be numbers because the gateway decodes the request into the OpenAI-compatible schema; provider-owned key semantics are left upstream. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

logprobs.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions log probability output. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

max_tokens.description: Legacy maximum completion token field. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion token cap. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

metadata.description: Application metadata for Stogas telemetry only. Stogas validates this object, logs it internally, and removes it before upstream dispatch.

modalities.description: Text-only MVP: when present, this must be exactly ["text"]. Image and audio modalities are rejected before upstream dispatch.

n.description: Number of choices to generate. Stogas currently accepts only omitted or `1`; larger values are rejected before upstream dispatch.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel.

prediction.description: Predicted output content used by compatible OpenAI models to reduce latency.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions presence penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

prompt_cache_key.description: OpenAI-only prompt cache key. Must be non-empty UTF-8 up to 256 bytes and must not contain NUL, CR, or LF. Anthropic deployments reject this field; use `cache_control` instead.

prompt_cache_retention.description: OpenAI-only prompt cache retention policy. Stogas validates that this is a string, normalizes known aliases before dispatch, and rejects this field on Anthropic deployments.

prompt_cache_isolation_key.description: Not supported. This provider-specific cache isolation field is outside the current OpenAI/Anthropic public Stogas surface.

cache_control.description: Anthropic-only prompt caching control. Stogas accepts `{type:"ephemeral"}` with optional `ttl:"5m"` or `"1h"`, validates explicit cache controls on text content/tool blocks, prices cache writes conservatively for holds, and rejects this field on OpenAI deployments.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for models that expose reasoning controls.

response_format.description: Provider-owned output format constraint. Stogas forwards supported OpenAI-compatible fields and leaves provider-specific format details to the selected upstream provider.

task_budget.description: Anthropic-only advisory token budget object for agentic loops. Provider-owned details are forwarded and do not reduce Stogas billing holds.

context_management.description: Anthropic-only context management object. Provider-owned edit details are forwarded and do not reduce Stogas billing holds.

inference_geo.description: Anthropic-only deployment routing hint. `global` selects standard multi-region pricing, while `us` selects US-only inference pricing. Stogas sends the selected Anthropic `inference_geo` upstream.

safety_identifier.description: Client-supplied safety identifiers are not supported. Stogas sets provider-visible safety/user identifiers from the authenticated API key.

seed.description: Best-effort deterministic sampling seed for providers that support it.

service_tier.description: Provider service tier selection preserved by the gateway. OpenAI accepts `auto`, `default`, `flex`, and `priority`; `scale` and `provisioned` are not available. Anthropic accepts `auto`, `priority`, `default`, `flex`, `standard`, and `standard_only`; all currently use standard-tier Stogas deployment rates. Anthropic `auto` / `priority` are sent upstream as `auto`, while `default` / `flex` / `standard` / `standard_only` are sent as `standard_only`.

speed.description: Anthropic-only deployment routing hint. `fast` selects cataloged fast-mode deployments where available; `standard` selects normal-speed deployments.

stream_options.description: Additional options for streamed Chat Completions. Requires `stream:true`. Stogas accepts `include_usage` and always forces it to `true`; `include_obfuscation` is not supported on Chat Completions.

stop.description: OpenAI-compatible stop sequence or stop sequence array. Stogas validates JSON shape and normalizes the string shorthand to an array before upstream dispatch; provider-owned value limits are left to the selected provider.

stop_sequences.description: Anthropic-only stop sequence alias. Stogas rejects this field on OpenAI deployments and rejects requests that set both `stop` and `stop_sequences`.

store.description: Not supported. Provider retention behavior is server-owned; requests that set store are rejected before upstream dispatch, and OpenAI-bound requests are forced to store:false.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Stogas validates JSON shape only; provider-owned numeric bounds are left to the selected provider. Anthropic deployments reject requests that set both `temperature` and `top_p`.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice. Chat Completions accepts `auto`, `none`, `required`, declared function choices, and custom tool choices where supported.

tools.description: Tool definitions. Chat Completions accepts function tools for OpenAI and Anthropic, custom tools where supported, and Anthropic-only `mcp_toolset` entries paired one-to-one with `mcp_servers`.

mcp_servers.description: Anthropic Chat only. Remote MCP server definitions paired one-to-one with `tools[].type="mcp_toolset"`; each server must be `type:"url"` with an HTTPS URL and unique name.

authorization_token.description: Forwarded upstream and redacted from Stogas raw request metadata.

top_logprobs.description: Provider-owned OpenAI Chat Completions log probability detail.

top_k.description: Anthropic-only sampling control. Rejected for OpenAI deployments.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling control. Stogas validates JSON shape only; provider-owned numeric bounds are left to the selected provider. Anthropic deployments reject requests that set both `temperature` and `top_p`.

user.description: Client-supplied user identifiers are not supported. Stogas sets upstream user identity from the authenticated API key.

verbosity.description: Text verbosity preference for models that support it.

messages.content: Reflect on the issue of trusting trust

object.description: The object type, which is always "chat.completion"

provider.description: The upstream AI provider that served the request

model_requested.description: The exact model alias or name requested

model_deployment.description: The upstream model deployment selected by the gateway

provider_response_headers.description: Catalog-approved response headers from the upstream provider

raw_response.description: The raw upstream provider JSON body, returned when requested.

message.content: You can never fully trust code you did not write yourself.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call ID for tool response messages.

refusal.description: Assistant refusal text when provided by the model.

audio.description: Not supported in Chat Completions requests. Stogas is text-only for the MVP and rejects message-level audio before upstream dispatch.

reasoning.description: Reasoning output when returned by the provider.

finish_reason.description: Reason why the model stopped generating

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion

ChatMessageContent.description: Message content as either a string or an array of content blocks.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls made by the assistant

ChatContentBlock.description: Text-only chat content block accepted by Stogas.

ResponsesRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible Responses API request fields parsed by the Stogas HTTP API.

provider.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

rules.description: Alias for `provider`. Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

input.description: Input for the Responses API. Stogas accepts a plain string or an array of Responses input/output items.

background.description: Not supported. Background Responses require asynchronous lifecycle and reconciliation support, so Stogas rejects this field.

conversation.description: Not supported. Provider-side conversation state hides prompt reconstruction before hold placement, so Stogas rejects this field.

fallbacks.description: Not supported. Stogas fallback policy is server-owned and client-supplied fallbacks are rejected.

container.description: Not supported. Stateful provider containers require separate lifecycle, isolation, and pricing controls.

include.description: Additional OpenAI Responses fields to request. Values are provider-owned and not enum-mirrored by Stogas; Anthropic-backed deployments reject this OpenAI-only field.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output token cap. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

max_tool_calls.description: Optional cap for priced hosted Responses tools. If omitted for priced hosted tools, Stogas injects an effective cap of 50 before dispatch. On Anthropic Responses, this field is only accepted when Stogas can translate it to hosted-tool max_uses; token-priced function, custom, and MCP tools must omit it.

metadata.description: Application metadata for Stogas telemetry only. Stogas validates this object, logs it internally, and removes it before upstream dispatch.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel.

previous_response_id.description: Not supported. Provider-side continuation state hides prompt reconstruction before hold placement, so Stogas rejects this field.

task_budget.description: Anthropic-only advisory token budget object forwarded as output_config.task_budget. Provider-owned details do not reduce Stogas billing holds.

context_management.description: Anthropic-only context management object forwarded as provider-owned runtime behavior. Stogas does not treat compaction as a hold reduction.

inference_geo.description: Anthropic-only deployment routing hint. `global` selects standard multi-region pricing, while `us` selects US-only inference pricing. Stogas sends the selected Anthropic `inference_geo` upstream.

prompt_cache_key.description: OpenAI-only prompt cache key. Must be non-empty UTF-8 up to 256 bytes and must not contain NUL, CR, or LF. Anthropic deployments reject this field; use `cache_control` instead.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for models that expose reasoning controls.

safety_identifier.description: Client-supplied safety identifiers are not supported. Stogas sets provider-visible safety/user identifiers from the authenticated API key.

service_tier.description: Provider service tier selection preserved by the gateway. OpenAI accepts `auto`, `default`, `flex`, and `priority`; `scale` and `provisioned` are not available. Anthropic accepts `auto`, `priority`, `default`, `flex`, `standard`, and `standard_only`; all currently use standard-tier Stogas deployment rates. Anthropic `auto` / `priority` are sent upstream as `auto`, while `default` / `flex` / `standard` / `standard_only` are sent as `standard_only`.

speed.description: Anthropic-only deployment routing hint. `fast` selects cataloged fast-mode deployments where available; `standard` selects normal-speed deployments.

stream_options.description: Additional options for streamed Responses. Requires `stream:true`. Stogas accepts `include_obfuscation`; `include_usage` is server-owned and rejected on this route.

store.description: Not supported. Provider retention behavior is server-owned; requests that set store are rejected before upstream dispatch, and OpenAI-bound requests are forced to store:false.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Stogas validates JSON shape only; provider-owned numeric bounds are left to the selected provider. Anthropic deployments reject requests that set both `temperature` and `top_p`.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Responses frequency penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Responses presence penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

text.description: Text output configuration, including structured output format and verbosity.

format.description: Provider-owned Responses text format. Stogas forwards supported OpenAI-compatible fields and leaves provider-specific format details to the selected upstream provider.

top_logprobs.description: Provider-owned Responses log probability detail. Anthropic deployments reject this OpenAI-only field.

top_k.description: Anthropic-only sampling control passed through the explicit Stogas allowlist. Rejected for OpenAI deployments.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling control. Stogas validates JSON shape only; provider-owned numeric bounds are left to the selected provider. Anthropic deployments reject requests that set both `temperature` and `top_p`.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice, such as `auto`, `none`, `required`, or a named tool object.

tools.description: Responses API tool definitions accepted by compatible providers. Stogas admits function/custom tools, remote MCP tools with narrowed allowed_tools, priced provider-hosted web search tools, and Anthropic web_fetch tools. See the Internal Tools guide for the current provider matrix and billing behavior.

user.description: Client-supplied user identifiers are not supported. Stogas sets upstream user identity from the authenticated API key.

prompt_cache_retention.description: OpenAI-only prompt cache retention policy. Stogas validates that this is a string, normalizes known aliases before dispatch, and rejects this field on Anthropic deployments.

stop_sequences.description: Anthropic-only stop sequence alias passed through the explicit Stogas allowlist. Stogas rejects this field on OpenAI deployments. Responses does not admit top-level `stop`; Chat rejects requests that set both `stop` and `stop_sequences`.

cache_control.description: Anthropic-only prompt caching control. Stogas accepts `{type:"ephemeral"}` with optional `ttl:"5m"` or `"1h"`, validates explicit cache controls on input content/tool blocks, prices cache writes conservatively for holds, and rejects this field on OpenAI deployments.

ResponsesInputItem.description: Responses API input or previous output item. Supported item types include messages, function calls and outputs, tool calls, reasoning, and item references.

output.description: Tool output payload for function_call_output and related output items.
